turns.input: *He looks at Jessa Rook, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Nicco finds himself standing in Heartstone Square, the massive wooden entrance to his tower looming behind him. The daytime foot traffic moves at a moderate pace—locals and a few travelers passing through, some glancing toward the tower, others hurrying past with parcels and baskets.

Across the way, a tall woman with dark hair heavily streaked grey stands with sleeves rolled above solid forearms, a small notebook tucked into her belt. A narrow pale scar crosses one eyebrow. She is watching him with the calm, unhurried assessment of someone who notices hands, luggage, and signs of trouble before faces.
